The work within this contract includes the acquisition and delivery of raw VHR optical satellite data and the processing of these satellite data into usable products, which will be made available via the Satellite Data Portal. The Contracting Authority intends to conclude a Contract with one Contractor for a period of 3 years, running from 1 February 2026 to 1 February 2029, including a unilateral option for the Contracting Authority to extend the contract three times by one year until February 1, 2032 at the latest. The Tendering Authority has a total contract value (including all three optional extension years) of EUR 7,000,000 excluding Netherlands VAT and (if applicable) including local foreign VAT and all other costs and/or fees.
